info.title: AI Visibility Platform API
info.description:
Measure how a brand shows up in Google search, Google AI Overviews and AI assistants, rank the opportunities and get content recommendations.

**Conventions** – JSON everywhere; errors are `application/problem+json`; every response carries `X-Request-ID`; analyses are asynchronous (`POST` returns `202` + `Location`, follow progress via `GET /runs/{id}` or the SSE stream `GET /runs/{id}/events`); `Idempotency-Key` makes run creation safe to retry.

post.summary: Register a brand and its competitors

200.description: Idempotent replay – the run created earlier with this Idempotency-Key

503.description: Service not configured or dependency unavailable

post.description: Returns immediately with the queued run. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe: the same key returns the original run (200) instead of starting another. Only one run per brand at a time (409).

get.description: Emits `event: run` with the full RunOut JSON whenever progress changes, a `: keep-alive` comment every 15 s, and closes after the run reaches a terminal status. Clients may fall back to polling GET /runs/{id}.
